question: What rotational action defines the avaguṇṭhana mudrā?
premises: A gesture is identified as avaguṇṭhana mudrā.
This gesture is rotated all around.
Such rotation is considered its defining action.
inference: The avaguṇṭhana mudrā is defined as this gesture rotated all around.
plain_english: This is considered the avaguṇṭhana mudrā when it is rotated all around.
